Devin: Quick debrief from today's canary: prefetch-probe + tiny-batcher enabled. Result: p50 -15ms, p99 -7%, cost/token -8%.
Sasha: Nice! What traffic split and duration?
Devin: 12h at 7% traffic. Mix: 70% short (<64), 25% mid, 5% long.
Kim: Any tail regressions or duplicate work from probes?
Devin: Probe duplication ~0.3% of requests, probe timeout tuned to 5ms. No measurable tail regression on long flows.
Rohit: Can we get the feature-flag snippet to flip on Dedicated?
Devin: Added to repo snippet and bench doc. Flags: prefetch_probe_v1, tiny_batcher_v2.
Ops-bot: Canary deployed for experiment/prefetch-probe-2309 at 2309990015  7% traffic.
Sasha: Plan for rollout? Region gating?
Devin: 7% -> 25% after 6h stable -> 50% after 24h. Per-region p99 must be within 10% baseline for 1h or rollback.
Kim: I'll add dashboards (probe_dup_rate, tiny_batch_queue_depth, p99_by_route).
Devin: Thanks. Will post 24h numbers here. :rocket:
